title: veronica minima
intro: Veronica minima, commonly known as small speedwell, is a small, annual flowering plant in the plantain family (Plantaginaceae). It is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Veronica minima include its ability to calm the nervous system and reduce stress, as well as its antimicrobial properties, which may help to combat infections. The bioactive constituents of Veronica minima include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
